actions.action: Separate requested bookings from stock-backed pickup commitments
actions.mechanism: Only an inspected, compatible item held against overlapping allocations can support a confirmed pickup.
actions.implementation: Track requested, confirmed, at-risk, returned-awaiting-inspection, and available states. Label bookings dependent on future returns conditional; inspection must precede availability.
actions.check: Simulate a late return and overlapping bookings: neither an uninspected item nor a double allocation may produce confirmation.
actions.risk: Conditional bookings need clear wording to avoid implied guarantees.

actions.action: Open a recovery case when returns threaten pickups
actions.mechanism: Explicit ownership and deadlines turn a late return into a tracked resolution rather than silent failure.
actions.implementation: Trigger at the return deadline or reported delay. Assign staff to offer consented substitution or rescheduling, contacting each borrower only through their supplied preference.
actions.check: Inject an overdue return: every affected reservation must receive an owner, decision deadline, and recorded outcome; unanswered cases remain unresolved.
actions.risk: Unanswered messages must never count as consent or resolution.

actions.action: Match substitutes by condition and accessory requirements
actions.mechanism: Separate compatibility checks expose differences that a shared tool category would conceal.
actions.implementation: Record inspected condition, functionality, and accessories. Filter candidates by booking requirements; temporarily hold a candidate and disclose differences through the supplied contact preference before requesting consent.
actions.check: Test missing-accessory and differing-condition candidates: neither may be assigned without explicit consent; expired holds must release stock.
actions.risk: Category similarity alone does not establish suitability or safety.

actions.action: Audit preventable pickup failures against original bookings
actions.mechanism: A fixed booking cohort prevents cancellation or rescheduling from erasing difficult cases.
actions.implementation: Preserve original pickup windows and event histories. Count library-caused cancellations and delayed fulfillment as disruptions; classify preventability against predefined feasible recovery steps and deadlines.
actions.check: Replay identical cases with cancellation versus missed pickup: the denominator and disruption count must match; report preventable counts alongside total disruptions.
actions.risk: Hindsight can overstate preventability; use information available before pickup.
